sources.note: Nothing. §2 (p.650) lists nine phonological traits of Songlin ending with '9)别义的声调只有 2 个' (only two meaning-distinguishing tones); p.652 notes 弱化音节 (reduced presyllables) in numerals 'two', 'five'. No word on 重音/stress.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Songlin language' and (zh) '松林语' (second-hand digest of Song et al. 2019 with page cites)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Reports three tones 55 / 24 / 31, ~50% of words high level (citing Song 2019:24); consonants Song 2019:18-19, vowels 21-22.
